files.pyproject.toml:
[project]
name = "qgis-plugin-analyzer"
version = "1.4.0"
description = "A professional static analysis tool for QGIS (PyQGIS) plugins"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.8"
authors = [
  {name = "geociencio", email = "juanbernales@gmail.com"}
]
license = {text = "GPL-3.0-or-later"}
classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 5 - Production/Stable",
    "Intended Audience :: Developers",
    "Intended Audience :: Science/Research",
    "License :: OSI Approved :: GNU General Public License v3 (GPLv3)",
    "Topic :: Software Development :: Quality Assurance",
    "Topic :: Scientific/Engineering :: GIS",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.8",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.9",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.10",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.11",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12",
]
dependencies = []

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/geociencio/qgis-plugin-analyzer"
Documentation = "https://github.com/geociencio/qgis-plugin-analyzer/tree/main/docs"
Repository = "https://github.com/geociencio/qgis-plugin-analyzer.git"
Issues = "https://github.com/geociencio/qgis-plugin-analyzer/issues"
Chaneglog = "https://github.com/geociencio/qgis-plugin-analyzer/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md"

[project.scripts]
qgis-analyzer = "analyzer.cli:main"

[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=61.0"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "ruff>=0.9.0",
    "mypy>=1.0.0",
    "qgis-stubs>=0.1",
]

[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.10"
warn_return_any = true
warn_unused_configs = true
ignore_missing_imports = true
check_untyped_defs = true
disallow_untyped_defs = false # Gradual adoption

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py38"
exclude = ["src/analyzer/templates"]

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "W", "I", "N", "UP", "B"]
ignore = ["E701", "E501"] # Permite if cond: statement y líneas largas

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
